tree_sha256_algorithm: For each addon tree: sha256 over the UTF-8 text built by concatenating one line per file, '<relative/path/with/forward/slashes>|<lowercase sha256 of file bytes>\n', with lines sorted by ordinal (case-sensitive) relative path. The digest is the hex tree_sha256.

modifications: WP-pause-1: pauses_game true -> false. The in-game pause flow (O-08) keeps the game's existing _paused freeze as the single pause mechanism (BS-07 'choose one'); with the template's tree-pause the engine stops calling main._process, so the P pause-toggle and the restart action while paused (BC-02 regression invariants) would die. The template script and confirmation popups are byte-identical copies; main.gd additionally sets parent_scene = null at instantiation (runtime-only, hosting choice) so the window renders in the game's own PauseLayer canvas layer instead of the template popup-parent reparenting, which raced the per-frame visibility sync and closed the menu one frame after opening.
